propositions: The compromised GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN was logged in plaintext via uvicorn access logs because the bot read the token from the query string (?token=) instead of from a secure header.
Fix 66af (Gerrit 1384) was merged to main but not yet deployed to production, so the leaky token-from-query-string code still runs in the production container.

The token is a shared secret used for three purposes simultaneously: Gerrit HTTP basic-auth password (outbound), inbound webhook secret (?token= or X-Rebar-Token header), and container environment variable GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN.
Rotation must follow deployment of 66af to avoid re-leaking the new token when Gerrit's webhook next calls the bot using the old URL-based mechanism.
The canonical rotation procedure is infra/gerrit/service-user.sh, which atomically updates the bot's Gerrit HTTP password, overwrites SSM, and re-renders webhooks.config with the new token.
